description: Ministry of Higher Education -  Competent Authority to the University of Vocational Technology
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Bandula Gunawardana) and detailed descriptions of his ministerial portfolio (Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation). It also names another individual (Senior Professor Wachcha Patabendege Ranjith Premalal de Silva) and specifies his detailed responsibilities as Competent Authority, including exercising powers in lieu of the Vice-Chancellor under various legal instruments. This combination of specific personnel appointments with detailed functional responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
